sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Applies Beguilement for 30 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 90. Confuses for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 90 seconds.
